items.source: bindingResult - the errors object to add the error(s) to. You can add more than just one error or maybe even ignore it. The BindingResult object features convenience utils such as a resolveMessageCodes method to resolve an error code.
items.translation: bindingResult - 用于添加错误(s)的错误对象。您可以添加多个错误，甚至忽略它。BindingResult 对象提供了便利工具，例如一个 resolveMessageCodes 方法用于解析错误代码。

items.source: Note that two error types are available: FieldError and ObjectError. Usually, field errors are created, but in certain situations one might want to create a global ObjectError instead.
items.translation: 请注意，有两种错误类型可用：FieldError 和 ObjectError。通常创建字段错误，但在某些情况下，您可能希望创建一个全局的 ObjectError。

items.source:
The error processor is pluggable so you can treat errors differently
if you want to. A default implementation is provided for typical needs.
items.translation: 错误处理器是可插拔的，因此如果您需要，可以以不同的方式处理错误。已提供默认实现以满足典型需求。

items.source:
Note: As of Spring 2.0, this interface operates on a given BindingResult,
to be compatible with any binding strategy (bean property, direct field access, etc).
It can still receive a BindException as argument (since a BindException implements
the BindingResult interface as well) but no longer operates on it directly.
items.translation: 注意：自 Spring 2.0 起，该接口针对给定的 BindingResult 进行操作，以兼容任何绑定策略（如 Bean 属性、直接字段访问等）。它仍然可以接收 BindException 作为参数（因为 BindException 也实现了 BindingResult 接口），但不再直接对其操作。

items.source: Usually, a field error is created for a missing required field.
items.translation: 通常，对于缺失的必填字段会创建一个字段错误。

items.source: missingField - the field that was missing during binding
items.translation: missingField - 绑定过程中缺失的字段

items.source: Translate the given PropertyAccessException to an appropriate error registered on the given Errors instance.
items.translation: 将给定的PropertyAccessException转换为在给定Errors实例上注册的适当错误。

items.source: Apply the missing field error to the given BindException.
items.translation: 将缺失字段错误应用到给定的 BindException 中。
